exposure: Mode of delivery (Caesarean section vs vaginal delivery)
cohort: Infants born by Caesarean section or vaginally
finding: Formula containing L reuteri DSM 17938 did not significantly alter the microbiota in vaginally born infants, but in infants born by Caesarean section, it modulated the early development of the microbiota towards a composition more similar to that found after vaginal delivery
mod_finding: Infants born by Caesarean section who received the formula containing L reuteri DSM 17938 had a fecal microbiota composition that was more similar to that of vaginally born infants at 2 weeks and 4 months of age, compared to infants born by Caesarean section who received the control formula
